description: Provision/Tear down a list of machines using the provisioning service

action.description: Action to perform, tear_down or provision

vars.description: The address of the provisioning service

machine_type.description: Machine type to request for the VM (e.g. n1-standard-4). Defaults to the PROVISION_MACHINE_TYPE environment variable, then to the service's own default

disk_size_gb.description: Boot disk size in GB to request for the VM. Defaults to the PROVISION_DISK_SIZE_GB environment variable, then to the service's own default (the source image's own size)

retry_attempts.description: The number of times to retry the provisioning if it fails
